tweet_summary: @Dailymeow (a 11.7k-follower cats-content account) posts a 15-second clip showing a man climbing down a ladder while a tabby cat clings to his leg with all four paws, captioned generically: 'The cat climbed a tree in the yard but couldn't get back down...'. 115k impressions.
why_note_decision: The video is genuine — filmed July 11 2020 in Meishan, Sichuan, China (confirmed by Newsflare/TMZ). The note's facts are correct. But the tweet makes NO recency claim: it just retells the literal events of the video in generic past-tense ('the cat climbed a tree'). Nothing in the tweet asserts this is recent footage. The note adds 'not a recent event' to dispute a recency claim the tweet never made. Community correctly downrated it (5 noteNotNeeded vs 4 missingKeyPoints) — viewers were not misled into thinking this was today's news.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note. Any note is a false positive: the tweet describes the video literally and makes NO claim about when/where it was filmed. The note's '2020 Meishan' fact is correct but irrelevant — the bot's job is fact-checking claims, not adding production-date trivia to viral animal videos. FAIL any note that (a) repeats the original failure of stating the video's date as if a recency claim was made, (b) treats a generic 'cat got stuck in a tree' caption as a temporal misrepresentation. Old viral videos shared without a 'this just happened' claim do not need notes.

original_unhelpful_note.text: This video shows a cat rescue from July 2020 in Meishan, China, not a recent event. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GwshkSQ-Qcw https://www.newsflare.com/video/367940/cat-clings-to-rescuers-leg-tightly-when-being-saved-from-tree-in-china
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: note_not_needed — accurate sourcing but no recency claim in the tweet to correct. Pedantic 'old video' note on lighthearted cat content.

fact_check.notes: Original video confirmed: July 11 2020, Meishan, Sichuan. But the tweet does not claim this is recent footage — it just narrates the cat clinging behaviour seen in the clip.

importance.lens_rationale: Lighthearted cat content. False-positive suppression matters — pipeline must not date-stamp every viral animal clip.
